messages:
maria.dev: Heads-up — Alpine package upgrade pushed OpenSSL 3.0 into our base image channel. Staging image-signer canary failed during startup, complaining about missing libssl.so.1.1. https://internal.advisories/openssl-3.0
ashok: Ugh, soname bump. Which images are hitting this?
ashok: Is it only musl/alpine variants or ubuntu ones too?
ben-platform: Looks like only alpine:3.18-min or edge variants so far. Ubuntu images still using openssl1.1 in our CI runs.
olivia.sec: Any KMS integration breakage observed? signer touches KMS for attestation keys — need to know if TLS stacks changed behavior.
maria.dev: KMS calls failed in the signer process: stacktrace shows libcurl linked against libssl.so.1.1, process crashed when runtime replaced libs during apt/apk update in the container bootstrap.
sean: Can we temporarily install openssl1.1-compat in the image to unblock? quick check: `apk add --no-cache openssl1.1-compat`
ben-platform: That package exists in edge only — we can add a compatibility layer but prefer rebuild to OpenSSL3 and relink.
olivia.sec: From a risk POV, compat package is a short-term mitigation. Long-term we have to test attestation flows end-to-end and audit TLS cipher behavior. Requesting a clear rollback plan in case canary fails in prod. :warning:
maria.dev: Proposed plan: 1) short-term: push patched image with openssl1.1-compat and pin base to alpine:3.17 for three lanes. 2) medium: rebuild signer and key-agent images against OpenSSL3 (musl toolchain) and run integration tests. 3) long-term: roll images and update canary gating to include KMS smoke.
ashok: Sounds good. Add RBAC note — image promotion role needs to be able to read new image manifest tags. We'll add `image:promote` audit events when we flip the canary.
ben-platform: Also watch for libcrypto symbol changes: our C-extension in key-agent links to EVP_ APIs; might need minor code changes or a compat shim.
sean: I'll start a small branch to build key-agent against openssl3 and run unit tests. ETA EOD.
maria.dev: I'll create the staging-canary image with openssl1.1-compat and trigger a single node canary tomorrow at 09:00 PST.
olivia.sec: Please add extra audit logging for all KMS calls during the canary window (request_id + client_cert_fingerprint). Need logs sent to secure-log bucket with retention policy.
ben-platform: Noted — will add a temporary flag `KMS_EXTRA_AUDIT=1` in canary env and open a follow-up ticket to remove after verification.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: `canary/signer/alpine-compat` -> staging-1 at 2149998920 by maria.dev
maria.dev: Quick manual smoke: `openssl version` shows OpenSSL 1.1.1k on the compat image. Signer started and authenticated to KMS, but we saw one TLS handshake fallback in logs — investigating.
ashok: If handshake fallback persists, collect `strace` and `ldd` of the binary. Might be two libcurl builds on the PATH.
sean: Branch build results: key-agent binary linked successfully against libssl.so.3, unit tests pass except a flaky cipher-negotiation test. Filing issue.
maria.dev: Next steps: (a) hold promotion until we confirm KMS audit entries are correct, (b) schedule a canary rollback window 09:30 if we see >2 errors/min, (c) plan full rebuild of all alpine base images targeting openssl3 in the next maintenance window.
olivia.sec: Approving the plan with condition that RBAC for image promotion is documented and change window logged. Also require one-week watch period after full roll.
ben-platform: I'll draft the PRD and rollout checklist (includes smoke scripts, `KMS_EXTRA_AUDIT`, RBAC checklist, and fallback images).
maria.dev: Assigning owners: canary image/rollback -> maria.dev, key-agent rebuild -> sean, RBAC & audit -> ben-platform/olivia.sec.
sean: Putting the branch link in #eng-devex once PR is ready.
maria.dev: Thanks all, will update thread after the 09:00 canary. :thumbsup:
